finding: The family-based delivery room model significantly enhanced maternal role adaptation, increased the rate of spontaneous delivery, reduced the risk for cesarean conversion and diminished adverse maternal and infant outcomes, as well as improved postpartum psychological status and positively influenced maternal self-efficacy and quality of life.
mod_finding: Women who delivered in a family-based delivery room had a higher rate of spontaneous delivery and a lower risk for cesarean delivery compared to women who delivered in a general labor ward.
